Structure verbatim; long message bodies truncated with ' [...]'. THE FINDINGS: (1) the room ids (`room_<hash>`) and story ids (`story_<hash>`) are the SAME id space the GraphQL ROOM_LIST rail already writes into `threads`/`messages` — an MCP row updates a GraphQL row, it never twins it. (2) `list_rooms unread_only=true` carries a NOTE saying the filtered list is ordered by room CREATION, not activity, and sorted by activity only within a page — so it is a change DETECTOR, never a 'most recent' list. (3) unread_only returns hasMore=false when empty (unlike list_offers, which says true). (4) On a story, `from_self` is TRUE on his own and ABSENT on inbound — never False. Direction is bool(node.get('from_self')). (5) Upwork injects SYSTEM stories that carry from_self=true ('The freelancer accepted your offer … Sender's note: …'). Treating those as outbound would falsely clear an owed-reply card, so config.MCP_MESSAGE_SYSTEM_MARKERS demotes them to direction 'system'. (6) The room list's latestStory.message prefixes the speaker ('You: …', 'Rocky: …') — a display convention, NOT parsed; direction always comes from list_messages' from_self. (7) `lastActivity` and `latestStory.created` are epoch MILLISECONDS as strings; `createdDateTime` on a story is a real ISO instant.
